name: Lincoln Plaza
demographics: Lincoln Plaza serves a diverse, middle-income demographic in Riverside, California, with a strong representation of families and working professionals seeking convenient access to everyday necessities. The trade area draws from surrounding residential neighborhoods with mixed household compositions, including young families and established homeowners. Visitors typically prioritize quick shopping trips for groceries, pharmacy needs, and fast-casual dining options, reflecting a value-conscious consumer base focused on convenience and accessibility.
description: Lincoln Plaza is a community-oriented shopping center located at 2975 Van Buren Boulevard in Riverside, California, serving as a convenient destination for local residents' everyday needs. This accessible plaza has established itself as a neighborhood hub, offering quick access to essential services including groceries, pharmacies, and a variety of fast food restaurants that cater to busy families and professionals. With a solid 4.3-star rating from nearly 1,200 reviews, visitors consistently praise the center for its convenient location and practical mix of tenants. The plaza operates daily with extended hours from 11:30 AM to 10:00 PM, making it an ideal stop for both daytime errands and evening dining. Recent visitor feedback highlights the center's role as a go-to destination for vaccinations at competitive prices, though some note that parking can be limited during peak hours, reflecting its popularity among local shoppers.
summary: Lincoln Plaza is a convenient community shopping center in Riverside offering quick access to groceries, pharmacies, and popular fast food restaurants. With a 4.3-star rating and extended daily hours, it serves as a practical neighborhood hub for everyday shopping needs.
